chunks.heading: Limitations on duty hours of train employees
chunks.text: Except as provided in subsection (d), a railroad carrier and its officers and agents may not require or allow a train employee to remain or go on duty for a period in excess of 12 consecutive hours, or to remain or go on duty unless that employee has had at least 10 consecutive hours off duty during the prior 24 hours.
